lead: Nvidia fell 4.12% to $156.14 the day before its first earnings since Jensen Huang resigned, leading a chip selloff that took the Nasdaq down 2.49%.
why: CNBC reported Nvidia's board is not considering bringing Huang back as CEO and is focused on its investigation, despite a ~180,000-signature petition and Trump saying he would not mind his return.
The Commerce Department issued a rule on remote access to advanced chips, aimed at Chinese companies leasing Nvidia computing power from data centers abroad.
Caution before Tuesday's results: analysts expect about $109 billion in revenue and ~90% earnings growth (Reuters); Nvidia's value fell from ~$5.8T in early October to ~$3.9T by Friday (LSEG).

sources.title: Stock market today: Dow and S&P 500 drop, Nasdaq sinks over 2% as Nvidia leads AI trade lower, Anthropic IPO looms (Yahoo Finance)
